_comment: Everything the AR page knows about a card. Add a card by adding an
entry here and dropping its compiled target in /ar/targets/<code>.mind.
constellation.nodes  x and y are fractions of the card back, 0-1 from
its top-left corner. Place them with /ar/calibrate.
constellation.links  extra line pairs by name. Every node already links
to the centre, so only the cross-links go here.
story                the longer telling, which is NOT printed on the
card. Shown only once the card is recognised.
layers               the story artwork in parts, back to front. Each is
an image the width of the card's lower scene, drawn
at its own depth so it parallaxes as the phone
moves. Empty until the layered exports exist.
